old.label: Current state
old.text: Current state: Desk booking runs through a shared Google Sheet maintained by the Office Manager. It breaks down weekly — people book the same desk twice, forget to release a booking when plans change, and there's no visibility into which floor is actually full until someone shows up and can't find a seat.

new.label: Current state
new.text: Current state: Desk booking runs through a shared Google Sheet maintained by the Office Manager. It breaks down weekly — people book the same desk twice, forget to release a booking when plans change, and there's no visibility into which floor is actually full until someone shows up and can't find a seat.

old.label: Why now
old.text: Why now: The company just signed a new hybrid-work policy that assumes desk availability is self-service. The spreadsheet was a stopgap; it's now actively causing complaints serious enough that the Office Manager escalated to their leadership, who approved fixing it.
